item.title: It's a girl thing! - KALTBLUT Magazine
item.description: A KALTBLUT exclusive story that blends girlhood, memory, and quiet intimacy through both digital and film imagery. Photography by Ember Pan. Designer and creative direction, and all fashion by Lexie Xu. Hair and makeup by Amber, Milena and Momo. The models are Annie, Jamie, Lucia, Natalie and Birdie.

item.title: Frivolous Cartoons - KALTBLUT Magazine
item.description: Introducing designer Kári Þór Barry. Photography by Berglaug Petra Garðarsdóttir. Makeup by Mac Iceland. Hair by Hár Akademían. Models are Airdem Basil, Tómas Lemarquis, Haraldur Stefánsson, Fannar Arnarsson, Curro Rodriguez and Anton Bjarki Olsen.

item.title: Sunflower Thieves Share New Video for 'Already Taken' and Announce UK Headline Tour - KALTBLUT Magazine
item.description: Leeds-based Alt Folk-Pop duo, Sunflower Thieves, are back on the scene with their poignant single, "Already Taken," accompanied by an evocative new music video. The duo, comprised of childhood friends Amy Illingworth and Lily Sturt-Bolshaw, blends dreamy soundscapes with emotional depth, appealing to fans of Marika Hackman and The Staves.

The models are Jett Bolt, Eli Flavell, Jude Baloula and Lui Burns. Fashion by The System, A.D Atelier and Togenesuss from Sanguin Studios, Nesforineska, Serapis and Isa Boulder from Error404 Store, Junya Watanabe from Swop Store, Miu Miu from Mutual Muse.

item.title: Track Premiere: Simone Ledet - Blame You - KALTBLUT Magazine
item.description: Simone Ledet, a name that's begun to resonate across the musical landscapes of LA, London, Stockholm, and Seoul, is ready to take the spotlight. With chart-topping hits and a steady rise as one of Denmark’s most promising young songwriters, she emerges from the shadows with her debut single “Blame You”.

item.description: Circa five years ago, two friends noticed a shift in Berlin’s Club Culture. “Nights were getting longer, everyone was putting more strain on their bodies, but no one was taking better care of themself”, Ravemore founders Dennis Mühlhauser and Mike Vollmuth noticed

item.title: Cowboy Clean’s “Grendel” Sets the Mood for his upcoming EP “Rubber Knife” - KALTBLUT Magazine
item.description: Cowboy Clean releases “Grendel,” a psychedelic and visually striking single complete with a trippy music video. The track offers an early look at his upcoming EP “Rubber Knife,” arriving February 13, and sets the tone for a project focused on introspection, experimentation, and something different.

item.title: Sculpted by Nature - KALTBLUT Magazine
item.description: A KALTBLUT exclusive. Photography by Paula Vázquez. The model is Oline Holmen, signed at View Management. Make up by Paula Garcia. Styling & Creative Direction by Mar Roca, Pawnee Cotacachi, Clara De Pablos and Marina Rebanales. All fashion by Studio Cumbre.

item.title: Anatomy of Control - KALTBLUT Magazine
item.description: A KALTBLUT exclusive. Photography by Robert Ryncarz. The model is Mikołaj Śmieszek from ModelPlus. Brands used are Manchak Apparel from TFH Concept Store Warsaw and Boss. "Anatomy of Control explores the male body as a site of tension between strength and restraint. Through movement, exposure and deliberate concealment, the series examines how control shapes vulnerability, form and presence."
